finding_and_fix.finding: First browser battery showed DOUBLE punctuation on clean read speech ("Sumit..", "today??"): Whisper already fully punctuates clean speech, and the M50 stage appended marks on top. Spontaneous audio (the boss clip, the M48 gap) arrives bare, so M50 never saw this.
finding_and_fix.fix: engine_already_punctuated() stand-down in EnPunctuationRestorer.restore(): when any token ENDS with a sentence mark (.,?!;:), the engine's own punctuation stands and the stage does nothing. Token-final only — intra-word marks (2.5, example.com, test@example.com, 987-654-3210) never count.
finding_and_fix.complementarity: Whisper punctuates clean read speech and leaves spontaneous speech bare — the stand-down rule applies the stage exactly where the M48 readability gap actually is.
